✨ **Another step towards learning and growing in the field of law!**

I am delighted to share that I have successfully participated in the National Webinar on **“The Indus Waters Treaty Dispute: Treaty Obligations, National Security and the Limits of International Arbitration”**, organised by **InternLex** on 16th November 2026.

⚖️ The webinar offered valuable insights into the complexities of international law, treaty obligations, national security and the role of international arbitration in resolving disputes between nations.

🌍 The discussion helped me understand how international treaties play an important role in maintaining diplomatic relations, addressing conflicts and balancing the interests of different nations.

📚 As a law student, I believe that learning goes beyond textbooks and classrooms. Attending such webinars and engaging with contemporary legal issues provides an opportunity to develop a broader perspective, strengthen legal understanding and stay connected with evolving developments in the legal field.

I am grateful to **InternLex** for organising this insightful session and providing a platform for students to learn and explore important legal issues.

Looking forward to more such learning opportunities and continuing my journey of growth in the legal profession. 🌱

#LawStudent #InternLex #InternationalLaw #LegalEducation #InternationalArbitration #TreatyLaw #LegalAwareness #ContinuousLearning #FutureLawyer
